key_decisions.rationale: Preserves following-rock tradition and christological identification.
key_decisions.before: and all drank the same spiritual drink; for they were drinking from a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
key_decisions.after: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank from the spiritual rock that followed them, and that rock was Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and all drank the same spiritual drink; for they were drinking from a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains divine displeasure and corpses in desert.
key_decisions.before: But with most of them God was not pleased, for they were struck down in the wilderness.
key_decisions.after: Nevertheless, God was not pleased with most of them, and their bodies were scattered across the wilderness.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But with most of them God was not pleased, for they were struck down in the wilderness.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps exact number and fatal consequence.
key_decisions.before: Nor let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and fell in one day twenty-three thousand.
key_decisions.after: Let us not commit sexual immorality as some of them did, and twenty-three thousand fell in one day.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Nor let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and fell in one day twenty-three thousand.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows pinned Christ reading and physical deaths.
key_decisions.before: Nor let us test Christ, as some of them tested and were destroyed by serpents.
key_decisions.after: Let us not test Christ as some of them did and were destroyed by snakes.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Nor let us test Christ, as some of them tested and were destroyed by serpents.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves both testing/trial senses and promise of endurance.
key_decisions.before: No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to man; but God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you are able, but with the temptation will also provide the way of escape, so that you may be able to endure it.
key_decisions.after: No trial has overtaken you except what is common to humanity. God is faithful; he will not allow you to be tested beyond what you can bear, but with the trial he will also provide a way out so that you can endure it.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to man; but God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted beyond what you are able, but with the temptation will also provide the way of escape, so that you may be able to endure it.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps ritual actions and repeated participation.
key_decisions.before: The cup of blessing that we bless, is it not a participation in the blood of Christ? The bread that we break, is it not a participation in the body of Christ?
key_decisions.after: The cup of blessing that we bless—is it not participation in Christ's blood? The bread that we break—is it not participation in Christ's body?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The cup of blessing that we bless, is it not a participation in the blood of Christ? The bread that we break, is it not a participation in the body of Christ?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Israel designation and cultic participation.

key_decisions.after: Consider Israel according to the flesh: are not those who eat the sacrifices participants in the altar?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Look at Israel according to the flesh: are not those who eat the sacrifices participants in the altar?

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves demonic referent and participation warning.

key_decisions.after: No, but what they sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God. I do not want you to become participants with demons.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: No, but that what they sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God; and I do not want you to become participants with demons.

key_decisions.rationale: Marks repeated slogan and two tests.
key_decisions.before: “Everything are lawful,” but not everything are beneficial. “Everything are lawful,” but not everything build up.
key_decisions.after: “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible,” but not everything builds up.
